title: Orsen and the Bell
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Elodie Villalobos, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
